caption: Don’t want to get in trouble for sharing this 👀🎈 but it’s just a historical pattern! For the past 5 years (2022–2026), Balloonfest has taken place on the first Saturday of November in East Rutherford, NJ. From 2023–2026, it was held in a parking lot at MetLife Stadium. Not open to the public, but I’ve seen plenty of locals with strollers and snacks watching from just outside the fence. 😂 No promises for future years! #nycinsider #nycmom #macysthanksgivingdayparade
